prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Click on the incident you want to investigate.

<!-- Image (...) -->

3. Click on the Investigations tab in the navigation bar.

<!-- Image (...) -->

4. Click on the + Investigation button in the top right-hand corner.

<!-- Image (...) -->

5. Write a full description of the incident in the "Incident Description" section.

<!-- Image (...) -->

6. Click on the Rating Summaries section, then click on "Rating Summary" box once that has opened. An event rating will automatically appear.
   a. The Auto Rating Summary will be comprised of the following:
      i. Relationship to Employee
      ii. Hours of Work prior to Incident

<!-- Image (...) --> # Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

b. Energy Involved automatically adds the values entered into the following prompts:
    i. Fall From Height
    ii. Forklift
    iii. Machinery/Equipment
